metric_definitions.text_codeword_flip: factual text codeword != foil text codeword
metric_definitions.text_dna_base_hamming_fraction: argmax-base Hamming(factual text DNA, foil text DNA) / L
metric_definitions.visual_codeword_flip: undefined and intentionally not reported: the image and its deployed visual code are fixed; captions do not re-encode the image
metric_definitions.visual_codeword_match_advantage: I(fixed visual codeword == factual text codeword) - I(fixed visual codeword == foil text codeword)
metric_definitions.visual_cosine_gap: cos(fixed image-only visual continuous DNA, factual text DNA) - cos(fixed image-only visual continuous DNA, one-slot foil text DNA)
metric_definitions.visual_text_base_distance_advantage: Hamming(fixed visual DNA, foil text DNA)/L - Hamming(fixed visual DNA, factual text DNA)/L; positive favors factual

protocol.foil_world: one target local slot replaced; factual global/others

exact_surface_context.definition: SHA256(slot_key + NUL + foil target caption with exactly the edited target span replaced by <EDIT>); no case or whitespace normalization
exact_surface_context.interpretation: This is a strict full-caption scaffold identity check. An unseen surface context does not imply an unseen generator rule and must not be called a template-disjoint test.

generator_rule_edit_template.definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON over slot_key, role, family, contrast_set, source_atom, and target_atom
generator_rule_edit_template.interpretation: This is the primary generator-leakage caveat. Reusing a rule means the lexical edit mechanism was observed in opt-train even when the natural sentence scaffold is new.

template_diagnostic.interpretation: All overlap/unseen strata remain diagnostics within the same E*-selection-used validation rows; none is an independent test.
